q: How many hours are on the books this week, and how do they break down?
options: 64 hours: 39 Compass plus the 25-hour Checklane Blitz
39 hours total, blitz included
64 hours of Compass, with the blitz on top of that
25 hours of Compass plus a 39-hour blitz
explain: 64 total: 39 hours of Compass and the 25-hour Checklane Blitz stacked on top.

q: A store hasn't finished the Checklane Blitz by the end of this week. What happens?
options: It rolls into Period 11
It gets scheduled again next week, with extra InstaWork help brought in
The store finishes it on their own
It waits until the next blitz rotation
explain: Stores that haven't completed the blitz get scheduled again next week, and I'm bringing in extra InstaWork help so we have the coverage to close it out.

q: On Cocoa, where do the syrups end up, and how did the test store work the set?
options: Bottom shelf, working top down
Top two shelves, working from the bottom up
Middle shelves, working left to right
They leave the set entirely
explain: Syrups move to the top two shelves and cocoa mixes sit on shelves one through four. The test store started at the bottom and worked up; it took two hours.

q: Milk Byproducts. Pick everything that's true.
options: Ricotta moves to the top left of the set
Refrigerated Hispanic and Refrigerated Italian strips record under Milk Byproducts
Squeeze sour creams go side by side
The 20-minute rule applies
explain: Ricotta goes top left, the Hispanic and Italian strips record under Milk Byproducts, and it's refrigerated. Squeeze sour creams go over/under, not side by side.

q: What happens to the 1-gallon Kroger Multipurpose Cleaning Vinegar?
options: It moves to the bottom shelf of Vinegar
It leaves the Vinegar set and goes to Household Cleaning
It's deleted
It moves to the top shelf, Kroger leading left
explain: The cleaning vinegar leaves Vinegar entirely and goes to the Household Cleaning set.

q: Four Kroger Rising Crust pizzas are changing suppliers. What's your job during the reset?
options: Pull them until the new supplier ships
Confirm the correct supplier product is on the shelf
Face the old product over to hold the space
Nothing. Supplier changes don't affect the set
explain: Confirm the correct supplier product is on the shelf during the reset. Same goes for Red Baron Crunchtime: verify your store is in scope before cutting it in.

q: The Kroger Au Gratin and Scalloped boxed potatoes have a new UPC and size. How do you treat them?
options: As a simple tag swap
As a hard add and a hard delete
Leave the old product and update the tag later
Move them to the stuffing section
explain: New UPC and size means a hard add and a hard delete: the old item comes out, the new item goes in.

q: Vitamins. What did the test store learn that you should plan for?
options: Shelves 5–8 shift left, and they needed four extra pushers
Shelves 1–4 flip entirely
The set took half the booked time
No strips came in
explain: Minor movement on shelves one through four, shelves five through eight mostly shift left, and they needed four extra pushers. Have spares on the cart. It ran three and a half hours.

q: True or false: on NF Vitamins, you place the 28 new items first and pull the deletes as you go.
options: True
False
explain: False. Pull the deletes first, then place the new items. Then work the 72 changes carefully.

q: Store 391's NF Vitamins planograms look different from everyone else's. What do you go by?
options: The planogram name
The planogram ID
Whatever the store manager prefers
Skip the set at 391
explain: 391 has its own store-specific planograms. Go by the planogram ID, not the name.

q: Which District 8 stores have the Diabetic Supplies set?
explain: 23, 53, 215, 391 and 658. The other five stores don't carry the set, so there's nothing to move there.

q: Where do the Home Testing items go, and which version is every District 8 store on?
options: Bottom shelf, WITH PEN NEEDLE
Top shelf, NO PEN NEEDLES
Behind the pharmacy counter, WITH PEN NEEDLE
They stay in their own set
explain: Home Testing items move into Diabetic, mostly on the top shelf. Every District 8 version is NO PEN NEEDLES. If a planogram says with pen needle, it isn't yours.

q: Drive Medical cane rack. Pick everything that's true.
options: No small peg hooks on the fixture
Remove any hooks hanging off the side, every visit
The survey needs photos of both sides of the display
Hooks are fine as long as the store asks for them
explain: No small peg hooks, ever. Remove strays on every visit. The survey is in the Retail Logic visit and requires photos of both sides.

q: You'll need InstaWork support next week. When do you tell me?

By Wednesday morning

Whenever the store asks
